summary: The Riftlands are the outer fracture belt of the Realm of Discord — a chaotic frontier of unstable rifts, Void breaches, temporal anomalies, and Discord-warped terrain. It is the borderland between Discord-Core and the deeper planar void.

events: Dimensional shockwaves from Discord-Core ruptured the outer layers.
Riftlands formed as unstable terrain collapsed outward.
Void breaches opened across the wastes.
Voidborn entities began crossing into Discord.
Riftspire towers formed from condensed Discord energy.
Riftseekers established anchor points to stabilize travel.
Time fractures spread from Discord-Core into the Riftlands.
Entire regions began looping, skipping, or collapsing.
